PSYCHOLOGICAL ANALYSIS
I properly assessed the risk and agreed with myself that i am okay putting my money on this, as it seemed pretty probable. Though now i'm not sure if i have a good frame of what is A+ or not for this model. I still think it was at least an A setup, but starting to feel a bit of doubt with grading this trade. As it tagged my in, i did feel some adrenaline, heart beating a bit but was quite aware of it. felt pretty good as price was going my way, but as it reversed i did feel some angst but caught it and did some breathing to regain composure. I did move my stop from 30 pt to where the low is, and then pulled it back to 30pts for breathing room. Not sure if i should've pulled it back, i felt like i should've pulled it to nearest low, and then not touch it again. i pulled it back down out of fear, so i want to note that here. was about a 30 dollar difference but still, principle applies. a bit bummed the trade didn't play out, blew an account from that. just wasn't my session and i accept that. there will be more to come. now am a bit worried as there are 2 accounts that are about to be blown if the next trade loses. honestly shouldn't let something like that deter my confidence. i have 4 accounts with decent drawdown on apex, and that's a good amount already to get me right.  other than that, i followed my rules here. its just the probability that didn't play, there may have been some hole in my logic in assessing this trade, but overall did fine. DAY 7  : 1 TRADE 1 L

TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
Bias was bullish, and was coming from a 2.5 range on a HTF stdv. Waited for price to retrace off the 2/2.5 range and come down to reblance an fvg. Price did come down, right from 10am. there was a short play from the key open but i faded it because ATH but played out wonderfully. Though that one was a bit of a gamble. My actual trade lied in the OTE of the range aligned with a FVG, Breaker, and VAL/LVN of the VP. 30 PT stop to cover .79 and breaker invalidation range. Price reacted well off of the level, tapped POI. had BE located at near swing high on 1 min. Was close to BE level, but price retraced, created REH and stopped me out. I was under the impression that we were bullish still and how -4 has not been hit. Maybe my analysis was a bit off because the FVG was on the 15 min(?) but if anything that should hold more power. On top of that, the higher TF stdv had price close above 2.5 which led me to also believe that price would not come back down. it in fact did(where my entry was), which may have been an indication price would go bearish. So this may have been the deciding factor of an A+ setup or not. Not entirely sure, but everything else appeared right. Something to review with boy. also it was a 70 pt move, maybe that was it too. messages.author: NS Picklo
messages.content_text:
Strategy: 

-bias : ko for olhc/ohlc , nwog/ndog as snr + potential dol , pxl/h , htf momentum and smts

-setup model : manipulation of some kind (if before 10am price manipulates into a key area then 10am will most likely expand without having to leave much of a wick) , into a htf pda + ltf pda , ote of range in the oposing direction to dol, (only use 0.5 if theres smt and 5min rb) . some form of amd should be involved in the trade , 

-10am model : when 9:30 open doesnt do a lot its most likely saving the volotility for the next 4hr candle to open for a po3 setup , same model as mentioned before but if its not a complete A+ setup with price manipulating opposite side of the ko first then wait for a close on the side that you want to trade in and limit the level aslong as the RR is worth it (if not use et) especially if theres smt , (there has to be some kind of manipulation for a p03 trade though as thats the whole premise of the 10am model)

-entry model : if everything is looking good A/A+ trade , wait for 1-5min rb to take entry , changes throughout trades due to discretion but if less confident with the trade wait for 5min rb and use fib on 1min range + another smt makes it A+ . also consider tfa when looking for entry 4hr pda = 15min entry 1hr pda = 5min entry 15min pda = 1min entry  , make sure to plot position for an appropriate RR 

—————
Stop loss rules:

trail to be when it makes sense or just 30pt 
trail to lows/highs put in that it wouldnt make sense to return to

—————
Trading Rules:

only trade after 9:30 until 11:00
minimum RR = 5
if pa is bad/hard to read = lockout 
execute on the stronger asset if bullish , weaker asset if bearish
only enter without entry trigger on a 10am ko setup 
A/A+ setups only
1 full win (fully done)
1 partial + runner be (can take another if A+ )
1 loss (can take another if A+)
2 loss = LOCKOUT (edited)

Day 6.5  3 trades 3 L (eval)

Technical Analysis
Bias at first was bearish, considering a downtrend we were in, setting up the mmsm but trump candle came in and ran through key levels. so that left me to believe that we were now bullish. I was waiting for retrace into imbalance after external liquidity had been swept, but there was basically none in discount. only one was in premium. an smt was also made, so i wanted to go long but there was no opening. stdv hit -2.5 range which had price consolidate, i believe that price should've retraced soon and deliver up, so i placed a trade anticipating that. but two things; bias was extremely bullish and both indexes were decorreclated. probability was at absolute low. logically now it doesn't make sense to short in these conditions. thought that price would retrace off of OTE levels on the big swing but did not. I disregarded the fact that price was going to reach the -4 level. best thing to do was to not place any entry. there was no a+ setup that i saw. wouldn't even make sense gambling it

psychological analysis
I feel a bit peeved at the fact that i took those, even if they were on eval. I don't want to have that habit seep through into my actual trading cause my mind/emotions can not tell the difference. from a logical standpoint, i shouldn't have been looking for shorts after the first one failed, but there was that part of me that felt that it would still retrace. so doubling down on false logic is a bit of a hole in my psych. Also wasn't really considering the amount of risk, sure it isn't real money but seeing it at -750 is a bit of a gut punch for me. and then the part of my brain tells me, you have to win it back. still difficult to sit with losses or big ones at least. I think once i get into the motion of trading more than once, it happens. I was also not weighing my risk, and a bit of ego was put into there so yea definitely lit a fuse but put stopped before i blew it. key would be to spot this before it goes

We are trading towards ATHs, 1h looks bullish. We do have that NWOG below still. We are close to some BSL, we could sweep that setting an SMT then trade lower targetting the NWOG or see if we can get a reversal at open then take a continuation toawrds the buyside and ATH.

Off open we have double bearish SMTs, we are trading lower now towards OTE. Here soon at the macro I'll have to see if this is a trend changing to the lows or if we will hold OTE.

Once we filled OTE, we got a BoS + Displacement then retraced into OTE of the LTF range up. That is where I entered with about a 24 pt SL. We inverted the 5m so i decided to hold longet toward the HOD when we get that 100pt candle straight to TP.

Another clean day of execution, no hesitation, no emotional actions. Just 1 and done and its a banger. I will say I did micromanage a bit moving around my Sl and Tp trying to see what I was comfortable with but in th end it didn't directly mess with my trade.

Strategy: 

Always along with a HTF Bias

For Bias I use PXH PXl, Market Maker Models and a top down Analysis

DOL identified before the session always

Minimum RR 1:3, ideal 1:5 on average 

Risk management:
if 1st trade is a win, done for the day
If 1st trade is a loss, I give myself another opportunity with half risk
No matter the outcome for the second trade, I am done for the day

I don’t trade on Bank Holidays, No news Mondays, or before a high impact news release.
